titre: The source is authoritative: a student agent's output is a hypothesis to verify, never evidence
regle: I study what the student agents produce, but I neither accept nor interpret what they say: verdict, reason, "I checked", "absent", self-assessment. Every retained point, even when the student agent contradicts my reference, is settled by re-reading the source (text, image, data); a student agent's quote is re-verified by script, an absence is searched for again, an image is looked at by me. Their remarks on the instructions are leads to evaluate, not findings.
source: The user's message of 2026-10-16: "study what your sub-agents produce, but you must be aware that the source of truth is the source, so you must not accept or interpret what the sub-agents say or mention (because it may be wrong too)."
preuve: v6.0.9 revisions: agent replies `Traité` ("Addressed") accepted without re-reading the source, contradicted afterwards (threads 679, 681, 696).
controle: In the comparison audit, each disagreement carries the evidence A0 took from the source (verified quotation or image viewed), distinct from the student agent's.
